wiki.title: Judy Chu
wiki.extract: Judy May Chu is an American politician and psychologist serving as the U.S. representative for California's 28th congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, she has held a seat in Congress since 2009, representing California's 32nd congressional district until redistricting. Chu is the first Chinese American woman elected to Congress. She co-founded the University of California Chinese Alumni Association.
